# GlassWave

GlassWave is a modern single-page web application for creating, editing, and managing notes with a visually appealing glassmorphism interface.

## Links

- [Home](/) — the entire app is one page (dashboard + settings are in-app views)

## Features

- Create and edit notes with a rich-text editor (Tiptap)
- Pin, archive, trash, reminders, search, and sorting
- Firebase sync across devices, offline support, guest mode without registration
- Multiple color themes and a multilingual UI (English, Russian, Korean)
- Installable as an Android app (Capacitor) or a PWA
